sitat: Our baseline estimates reveal that a 1% drop in benefit duration leads to a statistically significant increase of employment by 0.019 log points.

utfall: antall personer (millioner) som fikk jobb i 2014 på grunn av kuttet; over 1.1 millioner av dem ville ellers stått utenfor arbeidsstyrken
sitat: In levels, 2.1 million individuals secured employment in 2014 due to the benefit cut. More than 1.1 million of these workers would not have participated in the labor market had benefit extensions been reauthorized.
